TITLE: The Kindness Schedule
TEXT:
KINDNESS SCHEDULE (WEEKLY)

MON: text someone "thinking of you" without requiring reply
TUE: let the kettle boil; drink water before caffeine
WED: hold a door; hold your tongue; hold your own hand, briefly
THU: clean one small surface; pretend it matters (it does)
FRI: tip well; thank workers; thank yourself, quietly
SAT: take a walk with no optimization
SUN: forgive the week; plan less; breathe more

Addendum:
Kindness is not a performance.
It is maintenance.
